content:
Jordan Lee: quick heads-up, i'm preparing a small PR to consolidate various function/tool-calling examples into docs/snippets/tool-calling. mostly file moves + a tiny schema rename (output_schema -> tool_output_schema).
Priya Nair: sounds fine. can you standardize the example shape? reviewers get confused with different property names across snippets.
Jordan Lee: proposal: single minimal example we can reference everywhere: `tool_output_schema` with an explicit `result` object and optional `meta` that can be null.
Ravi Patel: please include a short paragraph about why we allow `meta` to be nullable (backwards compat with older tools that returned just a string).
Marta Lopez: also add a short parse-pattern section: validate -> attempt relaxed-parse -> fallback to `handler` (not "tool") to match ops policy.
Jordan Lee: agreed. draft schema i'm adding to the snippet:```json
{
  "title": "Tool Output",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "result": {"type": "object"},
    "meta": {"type": ["object", "null"]}
  },
  "required": ["result"]
}
```
Priya Nair: nice. for the README snippet, include this short python validate example:```py
from jsonschema import validate, ValidationError

def parse_with_fallback(raw):
  try:
    validate(instance=raw, schema=TOOL_OUTPUT_SCHEMA)
    return raw
  except ValidationError:
    # try relaxed parse
    relaxed = relaxed_parser(raw)
    if relaxed:
      return relaxed
    return {"result": {}, "meta": None}  # last-resort handler
```
Ravi Patel: for JS, prefer `await client.invokeTool()` in examples, and show how to `try/catch` parse errors.
Marta Lopez: don't forget to update docs links — i found at least three internal anchors that point to the old path.
Jordan Lee: thanks, i'll run a repo grep and include the list in the PR description. also adding a migration note in docs/migration/tool-calling.md with a 2-line checklist.
Priya Nair: PR please include updated SDK snippets that call `client.invokeTool()` rather than older `client.call_tool()`. small teams still using the old name get broken examples.
Jordan Lee: done in the branch. PR 701: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/701 - includes moves, schema, snippets, and migration checklist. summary in the PR body.
Docs Bot: PR 701 created and requested reviewers: Priya Nair, Ravi Patel, Marta Lopez. CI status: running.
link-checker-bot: Found 1 broken anchor: docs/quickstart.md -> #function-calling-examples (moved).
Jordan Lee: pushing anchor fixes now.
Jordan Lee: pushed anchor fixes and updated the contributor guide references.
Docs Bot: CI for PR 701 shows link-checker passing, linter passed, unit checks passed.
Priya Nair: quick content nit: in the migration checklist, change "relaxed parse" to "reparse with relaxed schema" for clarity.
Jordan Lee: done. thanks.
Ravi Patel: LGTM on code snippets and policy language. small ask: add one sentence explaining why the `result` object is required.
Jordan Lee: added sentence.
Marta Lopez: approving from docs side.
Docs Bot: PR 701 merged into main by Jordan Lee.
Jordan Lee: deploying the site preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/snippets/tool-calling/ (auto preview).
link-checker-bot: periodic link-sweep will run over main tomorrow; if any regressions show up i'll open follow-ups.
Priya Nair: great work team, this should reduce confusion a lot.
Marta Lopez: thanks for handling the anchor hunt.
Ravi Patel: one follow-up ticket idea: add a short eval example that asserts schema conformance on a sample prompt set. i'll file it.
Jordan Lee: noted, thanks everyone :shipit:
